'''''Bandit 1''''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Bandit Squadron]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it served as [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen's]] personal Z-95.
